returns: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery in original packaging. Opened audio products (headphones, earbuds) can be returned within 14 days of delivery for hygiene reasons. Return shipping is free for defective items; otherwise a flat 7.50 return label fee applies.
refunds: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after the returned item is received at the warehouse. Shipping fees are refunded only when the return is due to a defect or our error. Orders cancelled before shipping are refunded in full immediately.
shipping: Standard shipping is free on orders of 50.00 or more, otherwise 9.99. Express shipping costs 19.99 and delivers in 1-2 business days. Orders placed before 14:00 ship the same business day.
warranty: Warranty length depends on the product (6 to 36 months) and starts on the delivery date. Warranty claims require the order id. Accidental damage is not covered. During the warranty period we repair or replace the item free of charge, including shipping both ways.
